title: NEURODEVELOPMENTAL DISORDER WITH OR WITHOUT MACROCEPHALY

intro.text: This entry describes an X-linked neurodevelopmental disorder in which some affected individuals have macrocephaly (NEDMAC).

checks.claim: Neurodevelopmental disorder with or without macrocephaly (NEDMAC) is an X-linked neurodevelopmental disorder.
checks.evidence_quote: This study suggests that hemizygous variants impairing SMARCA1 function can cause XLID with other variable features, such as macrocephaly and ataxia, in men.
checks.explanation: The paper describes the SMARCA1-related disorder as X-linked intellectual disability. The name NEDMAC is the entry's own nomenclature and does not appear in the paper.

checks.claim: Some individuals affected by NEDMAC have macrocephaly.
checks.evidence_quote: Pathogenic SNF2 related chromatin remodeling ATPase 1 (SMARCA1) variants have been reported in patients with X-linked intellectual disability (XLID) characterized by macrocephaly and variable neurological symptoms.
checks.explanation: Macrocephaly is described as a variable feature, and Patient 1 had it.

paragraphs.text: Neurodevelopmental disorder with or without macrocephaly (NEDMAC) is an X-linked disorder marked by developmental delay and intellectual disability. Some affected individuals have macrocephaly and others do not.

checks.claim: Neurodevelopmental disorder with or without macrocephaly (NEDMAC) is an X-linked disorder.
checks.evidence_quote: Hemizygous SMARCA1 variants cause X-linked intellectual disability.
checks.explanation: The paper states that the disorder is X-linked.

checks.claim: NEDMAC is characterized by developmental delay.
checks.evidence_quote: This SMARCA1-related NDD is associated with a spectrum of involvement, including mild to severe ID/DD, delayed or regressive speech development
checks.explanation: Developmental delay is a core feature; 77% of the cohort had ID/DD.

checks.claim: NEDMAC is characterized by intellectual disability.
checks.evidence_quote: Here, we report two unrelated male patients with XLID due to novel SMARCA1 variants detected by exome sequencing.
checks.explanation: The disorder is X-linked intellectual disability.

checks.claim: Some individuals with NEDMAC have macrocephaly, whereas others with NEDMAC do not.
checks.evidence_quote: In the SMARCA1-related NDD cohort, we observe a combination of macrocephaly and individuals with a normally sized brain
checks.explanation: The paper reports macrocephaly in 49% of the cohort, with the rest having normal head size.

paragraphs.text: The MIM number of this entry places the disorder on the X chromosome.

checks.claim: The MIM number of the NEDMAC entry places the disorder on the X chromosome.
checks.explanation: not supported by any of the 5 cited papers. The paper gives no MIM number for this disorder.
